verdict: Amazon's sales rose 20% to $200.6B and AWS grew 37% — but the headline $62.6B profit mostly came from a $53.4B paper gain on its Anthropic investment, not from selling things.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $1.68 a year ago — flattered by the Anthropic gain

segments.name: North America
segments.note: Stores, subscriptions and ads in North America; up 16% YoY, earning $9.1B of operating profit.

segments.name: International
segments.note: The same businesses outside North America; up 15% YoY, earning $1.7B of operating profit.

segments.name: AWS
segments.note: Amazon Web Services cloud computing; up 37% — its fastest growth in 18 quarters — and $16.6B of the company's $27.5B operating profit.

opex.name: Fulfillment
opex.note: Warehouses, delivery network and shipping operations that get orders to doors.

opex.name: Technology & infrastructure
opex.note: Engineers and the servers and data centers behind the store and AWS.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Advertising Amazon's own services and winning customers.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: The back office — finance, legal and running the company.

opex.name: Other operating expense, net
opex.note: Small one-off operating items, netted together.

otherDetail: Non-operating income of $53,396M: a $53,415M gain in 'other income, net' — primarily the increased paper value of Amazon's investment in the AI company Anthropic — plus $1,295M of interest income, less $1,314M of interest expense.
follow100Note: The $26.62 of 'Other income' in each $100 is mostly the paper gain on Amazon's Anthropic stake — it is not cash from customers. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: AWS is re-accelerating
takeaways.text: AWS sales grew 37% to $42.2B — the fastest in 18 quarters, a $169B annual run rate — and produced $16.6B of operating profit, 61% of Amazon's total.

takeaways.title: Most of the 'profit' is a paper gain
takeaways.text: Net income of $62.6B includes $53.4B of non-operating income, primarily the revalued Anthropic stake. The operating business itself earned $27.5B — up a strong 43%, but a very different story from the headline.

takeaways.title: AI spending swallowed free cash flow
takeaways.text: Free cash flow over the last twelve months was an outflow of $7.6B, as purchases of property and equipment jumped $66.1B year over year — mostly AI data centers.

oneTimers: Non-operating other income of $53.4B, primarily from Amazon's investments in Anthropic, is inside GAAP net income of $62.6B. Excluding it, the quarter's story is operating income of $27.5B, up 43%.
